## Required checks

- [ ] The diff is focused and does not undo unrelated or concurrent work.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, local paths, account screenshots, QR codes,
      real configuration, private datasets, raw logs, copied articles, paywalled
      content, or suspected internal/sensitive material are included.
- [ ] Authentication, privacy filtering, secret scanning, and release gates were
      not weakened or bypassed.
- [ ] New dependencies and third-party material include provenance, exact
      versions, compatible licenses, and required notices.
- [ ] Relevant tests and `python scripts/verify_public_tree.py` pass.
- [ ] Production, signing, deployment, and legal claims are limited to evidence
      actually obtained.
